recognize_zh: 低倍 CD20 染色可見棕色陽性 B 細胞呈斑塊狀、帶狀聚集，部分沿血管周圍分布，其餘大片區域為陰性；符合淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫中 B 細胞散在、圍繞血管的分布。
features: Low-power view with patchy, irregular aggregates of CD20-positive cells
Band-like CD20-positive cuffs around vascular structures
Individual cell morphology not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemistry for CD20 shows a patchy distribution of CD20-positive B cells forming irregular aggregates and band-like perivascular collections, separated by broad areas with few positive cells. Cytologic detail and the size of the positive cells cannot be assessed at this magnification. The perivascular, patchy B-cell distribution is compatible with lymphomatoid granulomatosis when correlated with EBER in situ hybridization and the H&E findings.

ddx.vs: GPA shows necrotizing granulomas with neutrophilic microabscesses and vasculitis, and lacks clusters of large atypical CD20-positive, EBER-positive B cells.
DLBCL forms confluent sheets of CD20-positive large cells rather than patchy perivascular aggregates in a T-cell-rich background.
EBV-positive DLBCL usually forms sheets without the prominent angiocentric-angiodestructive pattern; distinction from grade 3 LYG relies on site and architecture.
